title: The Quiet Machine
author: Sebastian Iversen
blurb: Marguerite Underhill, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
